title: 第25章 库房遭贼第26章 武山炼体术
lines: 伤势痊愈后的黄子洞可谓是春风得意，成为了药膳坊里的风云人物。
他当时为了保住玄冰藤，拼死和千草堂的古拉贝等人斗争的壮举，赢得了坊主易恩光的高度赞赏。
这件事不仅让黄子洞摆脱了以往的小角色形象，还一跃成为了药膳坊的红人。
凡是听到他这番事迹的药膳坊下人和学徒，谁不对他竖起大拇指，暗自佩服。
“啧啧，黄兄真是厉害！”
药膳坊的人们常常在背后议论纷纷，目光中带着一丝崇拜和艳羡。
黄子洞一改往日的低调，现在经常跟在阁主易恩光身边，参加各种炼药集会，甚至有机会见识到许多顶尖的炼药师。
虽然这些炼药大师并不怎么在意这个名不见经传的小卒子，但黄子洞自觉受益匪浅，见识大开，尤其是对那些神秘的炼药之术，简直痴迷到了极点。
“嘿嘿，你猜怎么着，我居然跟千草堂的斯木上人也算是认识了！”
黄子洞一回来，就迫不及待地跟李骏炫耀。
李骏一听“斯木上人”
这名字，顿时一脸惊讶。
“什么？你跟斯木上人认识了？”
黄子洞得意地摆摆手：“认识不算什么，毕竟咱们玄冰藤的事儿，也在圈子里传得不怎么光彩嘛。
后来千草堂邀请我们过去，给我们赔罪，另外，我还亲眼见到斯木上人亲自出手炼药，那场面简直让人瞠目结舌！”
“真的？斯木上人亲自炼药？他怎么炼的？”
李骏满脸好奇，凑近了一步。
黄子洞眼中闪过一丝神秘，故作深沉地说道：“你知道，他们炼药的火是什么火吗？”
李骏皱了皱眉，摇了摇头：“柴火吧？不然还能是什么火？”
“嘿嘿，当然不是！”
黄子洞压低声音，双眼闪烁着激动的光芒，“他们的火可不是我们平常用的那种柴火。
你知道吗，他们有一种特别的火，封闭在一种灵器里，只要催动机关，火就从那灵器中喷涌而出，猛烈得很！”
李骏瞪大了眼睛，嘴巴都合不拢了：“还有这样的事？火还能封在灵器里？”
“可不嘛，”
黄子洞越说越来劲，手舞足蹈地描述着，“斯木上人就用的火器，听说是什么地火淬炼。
不过，我听那些炼药的老前辈说，火分好几种呢！
有地火、天火、人火。
尤其是人火，那可是仙人吐出来的火，叫什么‘元婴之火’。
你能想象吗？仙人用自己的火来炼药，火一吐出来，那药材瞬间就变得不一样了！”
李骏一听，心中的震惊简直难以形容，他一个劲儿地点头，仿佛这些听上去如天书一般的东西已经深深刻在了脑海中。
“真没想到，炼药还有这么多门道！
怪不得你最近变得这么厉害，黄大哥，你以后一定会成为顶尖的炼药师吧！”
黄子洞故作谦虚地摆摆手，嘴角却忍不住上扬：“哪里，我只是个学徒，打了半个下人工，路还长着呢。
不过这些事儿啊，也只有亲自去见识了才知道。
你说我回来，不跟你分享，岂不是太对不住你了？”
李骏咧开嘴笑了，满怀崇拜地看着黄子洞：“黄大哥，你真是厉害，这些东西我听都没听过！”
“我和你说，我们坊主可也是一名炼药师，我这次可是看到他出手，他把每一株药材...”
两人你一言我一语，聊得忘乎所以，直到夜深，黄子洞才打了个哈欠，倦意渐渐袭来。
content_en:
After recovering from his injury, Huang Zidong was very proud and became a famous figure in the herbal medicine shop.
His heroic feat of fighting to the death against Gulabei and others from Qiancaotang in order to preserve the Xuanbing Vine won high praise from the owner of the workshop, Yi Enguang.
This incident not only allowed Huang Zidong to get rid of his previous image of a small role, but also became a celebrity in the medicinal food shop.
All the servants and apprentices of the herbal medicine shop who heard his deeds gave him a thumbs up and secretly admired him.
"Tsk, tsk, Brother Huang is really awesome!"
People in the medicinal food shop often talk about it behind their backs, with a hint of admiration and envy in their eyes.
Huang Zidong changed his low profile in the past, and now often followed the pavilion master Yi Enguang, participated in various alchemy gatherings, and even had the opportunity to meet many top alchemists.
Although these alchemy masters didn't care much about this little-known pawn, Huang Zidong felt that he had benefited a lot and gained a lot of knowledge. Especially for those mysterious alchemy techniques, he was obsessed to the extreme.
"Hehe, guess what, I actually know Master Simu from Qiancaotang!"
As soon as Huang Zidong came back, he couldn't wait to show off to Li Jun.
When Li Jun heard "Master Simu"
This name immediately made him look surprised.
"What? Have you met Master Simu?"
Huang Zidong waved his hand proudly: "It's nothing to know each other, after all, our Xuan Bing Teng's affairs are not very popular in the circle.
Later, Qiancaotang invited us over to apologize to us. In addition, I also saw Master Simu personally refining the medicine. The scene was simply jaw-dropping! "
"Really? Master Simu made the medicine himself? How did he make it?"
Li Jun looked curious and took a step closer.
A trace of mystery flashed in Huang Zidong's eyes, and he said in a pretentious tone: "Do you know what kind of fire they use to refine medicine?"
Li Jun frowned and shook his head: "Firewood, right? Otherwise, what kind of fire could it be?"
"Hehe, of course not!"
Huang Zidong lowered his voice, his eyes flashing with excitement, "Their fire is not the kind of firewood we usually use.
Did you know that they have a special kind of fire that is sealed in a spiritual weapon? As long as the mechanism is activated, the fire will spurt out from the spiritual weapon very violently! "
Li Jun's eyes widened and he couldn't close his mouth: "Is there such a thing? Can fire be sealed in a spiritual weapon?"
"No,"
Huang Zidong became more and more enthusiastic as he spoke, dancing and describing, "The firearms used by Master Simu are said to be tempered by some kind of earth fire.
However, I heard from those old timers who refine medicine that there are several types of fire!
There is earth fire, sky fire, and human fire.
Especially the human fire, which is the fire spit out by the immortal. It is called the "Fire of Nascent Soul".
Can you imagine? The immortal used his own fire to refine the medicine. As soon as the fire was spit out, the medicine instantly became different! "
When Li Jun heard this, the shock in his heart was simply indescribable. He kept nodding his head, as if these things that sounded like a heavenly book had been deeply ingrained in his mind.
“I didn’t expect that there are so many ways to refine medicine!
No wonder you have become so powerful recently, Brother Huang, you will definitely become a top alchemist in the future! "
Huang Zidong pretended to be humble and waved his hands, but he couldn't help but raise the corners of his mouth: "No, I'm just an apprentice, I've done half a job, and there's still a long way to go.
But these things can only be known by experiencing them in person.
You said I would come back and not share it with you. Wouldn’t it be too sorry for you? "
Li Jun grinned and looked at Huang Zidong with admiration: "Brother Huang, you are really amazing. I have never heard of these things!"
"Let me tell you, our boss is also an alchemist. I saw him take action this time. He made every medicinal ingredient..."
The two of them talked to each other and got carried away. It was not until late at night that Huang Zidong yawned, and his tiredness gradually came over him.
